title: tables/1: the feature tables of a run folder
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli flow tables RUNDIR --json`: one entry per `.mzfeat` of the folder, sorted by file name, each read from its meta alone (`mzlab_feat::tables::entry`, the function the Flow column of the site calls over the same bytes). The step that made a table (instance, step, status, ms, warnings) comes from the `prov.json` beside it and is left out when there is none. A file that cannot be read is under `skipped` with its error key and the exit code is 1 (the document is then the `report` of an error/1 answer). Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/tables.rs, crates/mzlab-cli/src/flow_tables.rs.

polarity.description: only when the recipe of the table says (`polarity: Some(..)`, not both)

tp.description: the table carries a product view (tp/2)

crate.description: version of the crate that wrote the table

instance.description: the plan instance that made the table
